title: The role of Wigner rotation in estimating the specific angular momentum of a Kerr spacetime
summary: We study the rotation of the polarization due to the gravitational field in the Kerr spacetime and the possibility of estimating the specific angular momentum that parameterizes this metric. Our approach is based on a geodesic interferometer, that is, a Mach-Zehnder interferometer whose arms are defined by null geodesics, and a single photon propagating within it.
